Checking opponent positions, p2 at Reading is closest to the oranges and most likely to land there next, while p4 and p3 are further behind. Given 4 houses bumps rent from $550 to $750, it's worth pushing for, even though it leaves me tight on cash with mortgaging capacity and house sales as backup liquidity — I'll go ahead and mortgage Vermont first to fund the build.
